item.text: {"summary":"Restore default map braces and make {:n} tuples delimiter-free.","explanation":"The checked-in map assertions expect fmt::format(\"{}\", m) and the custom-pair map expression to include outer braces; both currently omit them because no_delimiters_ starts true. The {:n} assertion for p expects \"421.5\", while fmt::format(\"{:n}\", p) produces \"42, 1.5\". The {:n} assertion for t expects \"421.5\\\"this is tuple\\\"'i'\", while fmt::format(\"{:n}\", t) produces \"42, 1.5, \\\"this is tuple\\\", 'i'\". The tuple parser currently assigns comma-space even after removing brackets. Defaulting maps to delimiters and clearing the tuple separator for n restores these contracts while retaining the map n option's delimiter-free behavior.","edits":[{"path":"include/fmt/ranges.h","old":"      set_separator(detail::string_literal<Char, ',', ' '>{});","new":"      set_separator({});"},{"path":"include/fmt/ranges.h","old":"  bool no_delimiters_ = true;","new":"  bool no_delimiters_ = false;"}]}
